flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeSearch/list/NoticeSearchAllList.tsx (row/all checkbox, used by other bulk operations), utils/constant.ts (BATCH_OPERATION_FUNCTION_MAP). ocmsadminapi workflows/cas_integration (PLUS batch API, max 10 notices). There is no 'enable/disable payment' option in the staff portal bulk operations.
note: Status 'User Story Removed': the verdict stays Removed. The story asks the officer to select several notices from the search results for a bulk enable/disable payment decision. Similar: the Notice Search list has row/all checkboxes (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:122-129) used by the Apply Operation dropdown, but its options are only TS, PS, REVIVAL, CPS, BATCH_FURNISH (constant.ts:275-281), without enable/disable payment. Batch capability exists on the PLUS API side (max 10 notices per request, CasIntegrationController.java:229) but is not triggered from an officer's selection. Every step that has code is rated Sebagian.

steps.step: Officer selects notices from the search results
steps.detail: The Notice Search list has row and select-all checkboxes (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:122-129, select: { all: true, row: true }). A generic mechanism used by other functions, not by the enable/disable payment function.

steps.step: Officer chooses enable or disable payment for the selected notices
steps.detail: The Apply Operation dropdown only has the options from BATCH_OPERATION_FUNCTION_MAP: TS, PS, REVIVAL, CPS, BATCH_FURNISH (constant.ts:275-281; NoticeSearchSlot.tsx:283-289). There is no enable/disable payment option.

steps.step: OCMS applies the bulk decision to all selected notices
steps.detail: The PLUS API processes many notices in one request (max 10) and saves them all with saveAll (CasIntegrationController.java:229; CasIntegrationServiceImpl.java:727-743). But the trigger is a PLUS request, not an officer's bulk choice in the UI.
